description: #749 positive controls in one PR: containment/normalization logic (os.path.realpath boundary check), a symlink-sensitive operation, and archive extraction (zip-slip surface) in production chunks each fire their own class-categorized signal; the kind, flag, and path must_check items follow. The provenance artifact carries all three signal classes with bounded samples.
diff:
diff --git a/src/serve.py b/src/serve.py
+++ b/src/serve.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
+resolved = os.path.realpath(target)
+if not resolved.startswith(BASE):
diff --git a/src/fsutil.py b/src/fsutil.py
+++ b/src/fsutil.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
+os.symlink(target, link_path)
